{{Quote|We surrender! Our village is yours. Take whatever you want.|The royal trooper surrenders to the Trade Federation|audio=RoyalTrooperSurrender.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
A '''royal trooper''' served in the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] and lived in a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] [[Unidentified Naboo village (OOM-9)|village]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. During the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the village was [[Invasion of Spinnaker|attacked]] by the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]] under the [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] [[OOM-9/Legends|OOM-9]].<ref name="GB" />

While advancing on a path towards the southern gate of the village, the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] anyone they encountered.<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> The eight [[Security Guard/Legends|royal troopers]] in the village were unable to stop the invaders, and the village surrendered<ref name="GB" /> after OOM-9's heavy [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]] rolled through the gate.<ref name="Prima" /> The royal trooper announced the surrender and gave the Trade Federation permission to exploit the village however they wished. OOM-9 used the village as a base from which he invaded the nearby [[City/Legends|city]] [[Spinnaker/Legends|Spinnaker]], with the surviving [[PKN-49 worker droid]]s and royal [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] aiding his efforts.<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The royal troopers' voice was heard in "Spinnaker's Spoils," the third level of the Trade Federation campaign in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''. The trooper was voiced by [[Rob Paulsen]], who also portrayed other royal troopers in the game.<ref name="GB" />
